faq.headline: Questions before you pay.
faq.subtext: Quick answers on payments, handover, and warranty.

items.q: What payment methods can I use?
items.a: We accept KBZPay, WavePay, Thai Bank Transfer (PromptPay), and international card payments via Stripe. Message us if you need a local bank QR.

items.q: How fast do I get my account after payment?
items.a: Once payment is verified, handover starts immediately -- usually completed within 5 to 15 minutes with full Moonton email transfer.

items.q: What is DriveX Gaming's refund policy?
items.a: If an account does not match the listed skins, rank, or clean bind status before handover is finalized, we provide a full refund or instant replacement. Completed handovers (after {cap} verification checks) and one-time account purchases are final once full access is transferred.

items.q: Can I cancel my VIP plan anytime?
items.a: Yes. You can cancel from your account page at any time and keep VIP benefits until the end of your current billing period.

items.q: Are single accounts included in the VIP subscription?
items.a: No. Individual MLBB accounts and curated bundles are one-time purchases. VIP membership gives you early drop access, priority sourcing, and member discounts.
